CutScene.Text: At last the way was clear to the Aravein’s Citadel… but it was empty… deserted…
A search of its cold vacant towers soon revealed many of the books stolen from the northern Citadels. It seemed that Aravein herself was behind the Daemonic attacks.
But the Dark Elven Sorceress was nowhere to be found… she had fled, and her trail was well hidden.
